player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ {num_rounds}-round a IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kwa round biara, susuw biribi kati {min_guess} ne {max_guess}.
Wɔkyekyɛm biribiara, botae no ne (2/3)x(average a biribiara susuw),
na player a ne susuw no dɔɔso botae no na ɔdi round no.
Kɔ bae wɔ format yi '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nhyehyɛe a enni mu; mesrɛ sɛ fa wo nkyerɛɛmu no to hɔ s[<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ mu yiye a, ɛda {min_guess} ne {max_guess} ntam.

message.round_guesses: Ɔkyeame 0 hyɛɛ bɔ {guess0}; Ɔkyeame 1 hyɛɛ bɔ {guess1}. Enti Target no ne: {target}.
message.round_draw: Sɛ wɔfa akwan horow so a, wɔn ho ntɔ wɔn.
message.round_win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {winner} na odi nkonim wɔ ɔfã no mu!

outcome.p0_wins: Ɔpanyin 0 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɔpanyin 1 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.draw: Ne nyinaa mu no, wɔn ho ankɔ.
